hints.title: Count Occurrences
hints.text: Aggregate the total number of appearances for each distinct element in the input list.

hints.title: Primality Test Function
hints.text: Implement a helper to check whether an integer is greater than one and has no smaller proper factors.

hints.title: Early Termination Check
hints.text: Return true as soon as any frequency value satisfies the primality condition.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: U: count of unique values in nums
